notes: Qt 6.12.0; scene graph backend=software; platform=xcb. frame_ms = interval between consecutive QQuickWindow::frameSwapped (software: emitted by the software render loop right after QBackingStore::flush of the dirty region to the X window (xcb, MIT-SHM); RHI OpenGL: after the GL swapBuffers of the basic render loop (Mesa llvmpipe)). QT_QPA_UPDATE_IDLE_TIME=0 (documented in QWindow::requestUpdate and recommended for benchmarking in the Qt Quick Scene Graph docs; removes the default 5 ms update pacing unless --paced). Pacing BENCH_PACING=60: each tick is scheduled on a fixed 16.667 ms grid by QTimer::singleShot(nanoseconds, Qt::PreciseTimer) (public API, ms accuracy on Linux per Qt::TimerType docs). No redraw requested by the app: frames are rendered by Qt only when the scene changes. First 2 s warm-up discarded (scripts restart at t=0). List = QML ListView (reuseItems, cacheBuffer 600, delegate height = row-height role) over a C++ QAbstractListModel (rows computed in data()). Scripted offset is exact (prefix sums of h(i)); the view is anchored with positionViewAtIndex()+remainder and then scrolled by exact pixel deltas (ListView's contentHeight is only an estimate for variable heights). rows_drawn = data(TitleRole) calls (delegate creations + reuse rebinds).
version: Qt 6.12.0 (runtime 6.12.0, aqtinstall linux_gcc_64 from download.qt.io), g++ 13.3.0, CMake 4.4.4, Ninja 1.13.2
